decisions.question: C has no class inheritance or interface hierarchy grammar constructs.
decisions.resolution: NOT APPLICABLE: C emits no extends, implements, or overrides relationships.

decisions.question: Function pointers, macro expansion, and preprocessor control flow cannot always be resolved statically.
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: opaque function-pointer targets and macro-expanded semantics are not fabricated as named relationships.

decisions.resolution: The inventory is exhaustive for the current grammar; future grammar drift requires a new inventory review.

decisions.node_type: macro-mangled ERROR regions (EXPORT-macro prototypes, SQLITE_WSD phantom functions)
decisions.question: M37 #601 Holy C wave residuals (pinned 2026-09-05): sqlite 100% coverage @60/lang = 9 missing / 105 unexplained (242 @200/lang, 1.07%); jq 99.9% @60 = 4 missing / 28 unexplained (0.94%). Nearly all unexplained sit in 4 GENERATED amalgamation files (autosetup/jimsh0.c, ext/wasm/libcmpp.c, ext/jni/src/c/sqlite3-jni.c, sqlite3-wasm.c) whose JIM_EXPORT/CMPP__EXPORT prototypes and SQLITE_WSD macro-qualified struct definitions cannot parse without macro expansion (C-D2); missing = include-guard macro uses (JIM_SIGNAL_H/__JIM__H/...) and vendored dtoa config macros read inside ERROR-recovered preproc regions; real-file residuals are edges where the ANALYZER is correct (fn-pointer table value reads; ERROR-scope desync in jq builtin.c after a 12-line ERROR span at L2055). The glue-name asymmetry (analyzer isGlueFdName vs oracle isBareFdGlueName, F7 identity-antipattern) was closed positionally so glue-fd names (s3jni_config_log) are suppressed on BOTH sides.
decisions.resolution: RECORDED RESIDUAL: not fixable without macro expansion / whole-file ERROR-span rescoping; the CGD19/CGD33/CGD38 positional artifact rules suppress post-glue variable/type artifacts on BOTH sides. Guarded by: differential baseline floor (sqlite 9/105, jq 4/28 @60/lang - section E validates the jq:c row against this ruling), fixture cgd31-37-regressions pins CGD31-38, regression mutants all caught (251 total incl. 10 c). Any future grammar or corpus change that shifts these numbers regresses the baseline gate.
